summary: Tested Expert Dashboard Equations Browser feature. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend displays 967+ mathematical models correctly with search, filter by organ system, filter by category, and review form functionality. Fixed a critical frontend bug where model.variables.slice().map() failed for non-array variables.

fixed_issues.issue: TypeError: model.variables.slice(...).map is not a function - Some models have variables as string or dict instead of array
fixed_issues.fix: Added Array.isArray() check and fallback rendering for non-array variables

expert_login.details: Login with admin@phicor.ai / admin123 works correctly

expert_dashboard_loads.details: Dashboard loads after login with all tabs visible

equations_tab.details: Shows 7892+ equations badge, displays 967+ mathematical models from API

mathematical_models_api.details: GET /api/expert/mathematical-models returns 967 models with correct structure including category_summary and organ_system_summary

equations_browser_display.details: Shows model names, equations/formulas, variables with units and normal ranges, normal values, abnormal conditions, evidence sources, clinical significance

filter_by_organ_system.details: Dropdown filter for organ systems (cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, etc.) works correctly

filter_by_category.details: Dropdown filter for categories (Physiological Models, Drug Models, Disease Models, Food/Nutrient Models) works correctly

search_functionality.details: Search by name, formula, or description works correctly

review_form.details: Review button expands model details and shows review form with status dropdown, source verification input, notes textarea, and Submit Review button

context_for_next_testing_agent: Expert Dashboard Equations Browser is fully functional. The /api/expert/mathematical-models endpoint returns 967+ models. Frontend fix was applied to handle non-array variables (some models have variables as string or dict). All features tested: login, dashboard, equations tab, filters, search, and review form.
